sources.author: Jibon's Notes
patch_list: Backup to folder
Adds a Backup row to the bottom of the side menu: backs up changed notes as .sdocx files to a folder you choose (any folder, including SD card or a synced folder).
Branding
Your own app name, the Notes pen logo as launcher icon, and an accent colour in place of Samsung's blue.
Crash fixes
Reports no iris scanner, and finds the pen settings layouts and colour palettes after a package rename (otherwise the colour picker crashes).
Finger drawing
Turns off "S Pen only" by default (once, at first start), so fingers can draw and scroll. Without it, the app assumes an S Pen and ignores finger input in notes.
Folder sync
Experimental. Syncs notes with other devices through a shared folder (for example one kept in sync by Syncthing): "Sync now" in the Backup menu, and automatically each time the app opens.
Hide camera
Removes Insert > Camera from the editor.
Hide Samsung account features
Hides Samsung Cloud sync, sign-in prompts, sharing, Galaxy AI and note locking. They need a Samsung-signed app; this matters mostly on Samsung phones, where the account exists.
Manifest compatibility
Makes One UI-only libraries optional (otherwise the install fails), gives foreground services a type (Android 14+ crashes without one) and drops multiArch.
Pen button actions

Lets the pen's two buttons run actions (pen, eraser, undo, colour picker, page up/down...) with single, double and long press. Set up in Settings > Pen button actions. Works with pens whose buttons send key presses (the Redmi Smart Pen sen…
Samsung framework compatibility
Adds stand-ins for One UI framework classes and redirects calls to One UI-only methods and fields, so the app runs on non-Samsung Android.
Treat as pen device
Turns on the app's pen features (pen toolbar, hover) on a device with an active pen that isn't a Samsung S Pen. Leave it off on devices without an active pen.
Turn off Samsung cloud components
Turns off the Samsung account, cloud sync, push and co-editing services and receivers. They can't work in a patched app and would only run in the background.
